summary: PO of 25.10.2023, section 7: seven compulsory 6-ECTS modules, the 18-ECTS applied research project, one bridging module (WP I), two business electives (WP II), one food elective (WP III), one free profile module and the 30-ECTS thesis. The program is run jointly with Hochschule Fulda, so many modules do not appear in Kassel's eCampus; the food elective and bridging module have no separate area in the data.

categories.name: Business electives
categories.note: Two 6-ECTS modules (WP II) over the program; only part of the catalogue runs each semester
